about_the_game:
Charm your heroes, heroines, and players with the RPG Character Pack 17! Gee-kun-soft’s latest MV / MZ-style character pack offers up 16 succubuses to add some devilish fun to your game world. Add the demon lord’s top soldiers to your game with this group of ladies who have a variety of horns, wings, tails, and lightweight outfits that will distract your heroes in combat while the succubuses steal their hearts (and life)!

Each character comes with walking and downed sprites, front view enemy battlers with 13 color variations, facesets with 8 emotions, SV battlers, and waist-up busts with 8 emotions so that you can use these ladies wherever you want! Have a blue-skinned, bat-winged, smiling succubus be a repeating foe that challenges your hero to a battle every time they complete a dungeon, and give your players the chance to woo a two-tailed thief to have her join the party instead of robbing them. Or ditch the trope of the main character being a teen boy and tell a story about the challenges of being a succubus in the demon lord’s army who just wants to enjoy life and settle down!

This pack also includes high-res images of each character, so you can introduce them from head-to-toe! Resize the images to perfectly fit your screen size, or add them into your game’s codex so players can remind themselves who each succubus is and what they’re favorite treats are. If your game has been lacking some mischievous NPCs or you want a unique heroine to lead a ragtag party, check out the RPG Character Pack 17!


Contents:

16 female characters come with:

・Battlers with 13 variants each
・Busts and Facesets with 8 emotions each
・SV-animated battlers
・Walking sprites + down pose
・Bonus portraits!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
